vo_open.text: This scientist put his head in a particle accelerator.

vo.text: Anatoli Bugorski was checking faulty equipment on the U-70 synchrotron in the Soviet Union.
vo.cap: Anatoli Bugorski. The *U-70 synchrotron.* Faulty equipment.

vo.text: A proton beam went straight through his head. He saw a flash, brighter than a thousand suns.
vo.cap: A *proton beam* through his head. A flash *brighter than a thousand suns.*

vo.text: He felt no pain. But the dose was far beyond what doctors thought anyone could survive.
vo.cap: *No pain.* But a dose far beyond anything *survivable.*

vo.text: The left half of his face was paralyzed, and he lost the hearing in his left ear.
vo.cap: Left half of his face *paralyzed.* Left ear: *deaf.*

vo.text: But his mind was fine. He finished his PhD, and kept working as a physicist.
vo.cap: But his mind was *fine.* He finished his *PhD.*
